propositions: A new BindingRepository must own live, retired, rotation, and alert file persistence with exact byte-identical sorted/indented JSON round-tripping and no eager writes on construction.
Calling save must unconditionally attempt rotation persistence before live replacement, retaining the inline last_get_pass floor if rotation fails without raising.
Corrupt live state must raise ValueError and preserve the file; corrupt retired state must fail open, return empty, preserve the file, and attempt deduped alerts that are swallowed on failure.

Rotation, retired, and live persistence failures must follow a strict order: rotation failure leaves sidecar old and live new; retired failure rolls back and raises; live failure after successful rotation/retired operations preserves earlier writes, cleans temp, and raises.
After a rotation persistence failure, the next successful save must write the retained inline floor from live to the sidecar before replacing live, enabling convergence across two save calls.
Alert persistence failure must not alter the result of a successful state-file write.
